name: datefield-rac
blurb: Segmented date/time input with individual fields for month, day, year, and time.
description: A set of composable components (DateField, DateInput, TimeField, DateSegment) built on react-aria-components. Users tab through editable segments for date/time values. Includes focus and invalid states.
use_when: You need precise date/time entry with keyboard-only interaction, such as for accessibility-focused forms.
avoid_when: When users prefer clicking to selecting — segmented input requires tabbing through each field.
a11y: Full keyboard navigation with segment-by-segment input. Handles aria-invalid states and announces focus.
